text.p: Rivers have receded somewhat in the Grand Forks and Fargo in North Dakota, USA. Flooding continues in the region, however, but should slowly ease in the coming days unless heavy rain occurs. None is expected during the next few days, at least. Rain is possible by Friday, but it is too early to tell how heavy it will be. Meanwhile, flood crests have reached the Canadian border and are expected to move toward Winnepeg during the course of this week.
There are no further statements at this time.
